Name: Sea-Dweller’s Aspect
Description:
Your body is altered to be better suited to underwater activity.

For the spell's duration, you:
● Can breathe both air and water.
● Can walk on the surface of water (but not other liquids).
● Gain a swim speed of 60 feet.
● Suffer no penalties related to deep-sea temperatures, choppy or torrid water currents, or normal underwater combat penalties.

While submerged, you also gain darkvision out to 240 feet, and when you speak, your voice is carried through the water to creatures within 60 feet of you.

You can perform verbal spell components underwater without issue.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
